invalid: Couldn't read these repository details. Check the directory name, source ref and issue/PR links; your input is kept.
limit: Use at most 20 repositories and 50 links per repository.
readonly: This device can only view repository links.
not_found: This to-do or repository is unavailable in this assistant.
store_unavailable: Couldn't confirm repository links were read or saved. Reload before retrying; a change may have taken effect.
revision_conflict: The repository links changed elsewhere. Reload and reconcile your edits.
catalog_conflict: The saved repository list changed. Reload it before saving.
duplicate_alias: Choose a different directory name for each repository.
duplicate_link: This issue or pull request is already linked.
link_repository_mismatch: Use an issue or pull request link from this repository.
no_provider: {provider} isn't installed. Saved links are kept; install it in Settings › Extensions to add new ones.
provider_off: {provider} is off or not running. Saved links are kept; turn it on in Settings › Extensions to add new ones.
provider_not_found: {provider} can't find this issue or pull request. Check the link.
provider_not_signed_in: {provider} isn't signed in. Check its settings in Settings › Extensions.
providers_starting: Extensions are still starting, so new links can't be looked up yet. Saved links are kept; try again in a moment.
